## Current priority

Release two demonstration products as quickly as possible:
1. New Year invitation — first.
2. Wedding invitation — second.

Current sequence:
1. Documentation navigation and release plan alignment — completed Nov 14.
2. Focused code review of the existing Demo scaffold — completed Nov 14; no confirmed P0 blockers found, several P1 mismatches recorded.
3. Design the invitation templates using the existing functional base.
4. Use one fixed template per product; defer any user-facing theme selector. New Year is first/default on the demo start page, wedding signature is enabled by default, and mixed family greeting styles are rendered per guest.
5. Prepare and demonstrate the New Year product first.
6. Prepare and demonstrate the wedding product next.
7. Defer nonessential improvements until demonstrations begin.

Previously discussed wedding visual decisions must be preserved. The New Year interactive fairytale story was already agreed: a layered fairytale conifer forest opens onto a clearing with a stump and ribboned envelope; the envelope opens and reveals a magical sheet with gradually appearing invitation text; the sheet exits upward; a blurred clearing remains with RSVP; decline shows a closed envelope and edit-response action; confirmation reveals a new sheet from a flash. Full scenario: https://github.com/pelzdesign/eventflow-media/blob/main/references/products/new-year/fairytale/NEW_YEAR_STORY_SCENARIO.md.

## Visual reference library

- Private media/reference repository: https://github.com/pelzdesign/eventflow-media
- Central asset register: ASSET_INDEX.md
- New Year fairytale references and scenario: references/products/new-year/fairytale/
- Before any visual task, inspect the repository tree and index. Do not ask the owner to re-send materials until the repository has been checked. Respect asset status, version, and rights.

## Source hierarchy

- Approved specifications and full working roadmap: private repository pelzdesign/EventFlow.
- Public Demo code and verified user-flow status: pelzdesign/eventflow-demo.
- Detailed architecture, audits, database materials, decisions and changelog: private repository pelzdesign/eventflow-project-docs.
- This public Hub: curated navigation and summary only; not a source of truth when private or live Demo sources differ.

## Important limitations

The public Demo uses SharedWorker and in-memory session data. It is not persistent storage and is not connected to the production Supabase database. Do not promise persistence across completed sessions or independent devices.

## Public Demo

- Start: https://pelzdesign.github.io/eventflow-demo/demo.html
- Organizer: https://pelza83.github.io/eventflow-demo/demo-organizer.html
- Guest invitation: https://pelza83.github.io/eventflow-demo/demo-guest.html

Open both organizer and guest pages through the start page to use the same demo session.
